user_period_settings.title: User Period Settings
user_period_settings.description: Personalized advanced calendar and menstrual period settings for each user

uid.description: The unique identifier of the user

cycleLengthMin.description: The minimum cycle length in days

cycleLengthMax.description: The maximum cycle length in days

cycleLengthTypical.description: The average/typical cycle length in days

periodLength.description: The average period/menstruation duration in days

lastPeriodStartDate.description: The starting date of the last menstrual period (YYYY-MM-DD)

pmsNotificationEnabled.description: Whether the user wants notifications for PMS predictions

pmsNotificationDaysBefore.description: Number of days before PMS starts to send notification

showPmsPredictions.description: Whether to display PMS predictions on the calendar

updatedAt.description: The timestamp when the settings were last saved

memories.title: Memories
memories.description: Shared sweet memories written by the couple with titles, dates, optional images, and content stories

coupleId.description: The unique identifier of the couple

date.description: The Persian/Jalali date or YYYY-MM-DD of the memory

imageUrl.description: The Base64 encoded or URL of the memory cover photo

content.description: The story/body text of the memory

createdBy.description: The UID of the partner who logged this memory

createdByName.description: The display name of the partner who logged this memory

private_expenses.title: Private Expenses
private_expenses.description: Private financial transactions (income or expense) logged by an individual partner, hidden from the other partner

userId.description: The UID of the user who owns this transaction

private_budgets.title: Private Budgets
private_budgets.description: Private budget limits for categories and monthly goals configured by an individual partner

userId.description: The UID of the user who owns this budget

budgets.description: A map of category names to budget limit amounts

/user_period_settings/{userId}.description: Collection of personalized advanced settings for each user

/memories/{memoryId}.description: Collection of shared sweet memories of the couple

/private_expenses/{expenseId}.description: Collection of private individual expenses and incomes

/private_budgets/{userId}.description: Private category budget configurations for each user
